entry.title: HEADDRUMZ KNOCK 0.4.8
entry.summary: First free release of HEADDRUMZ KNOCK, a stereo drum impact effect for kicks and 808s. KNOCK includes transient shaping, saturation, six genre presets, a live EQ curve, level-matched A/B, and a Drive Level meter with a HOT indicator. Tested on MPC XL Standalone. Requires MPC OS 3.10.1 or later with External Plugin Support enabled. Manual install: Download KNOCK-0.4.8-mpc-aarch64.zip, unzip it, and copy the HEADDRUMZ - VST - KNOCK folder from inside portable into VST2 Plugins on your MPC drive. R
